say:2:1220221001:1.text:
Hugin, have you made up your mind?
Are you planning on leaving Rustport?
say:2:1220221001:1.source_cn: 呼金？你考虑好了吗？\n留下，还是离开？

say:3:1220221002:1.text: Bah, that's all in the past now! Sonja, is there a quiet place in Rustport that's clean and suitable for research?
say:3:1220221002:1.source_cn: 不说那个了！索尼娅，锈锚港里有没有安静点，适合做研究的...

say:4:1220221003:1.text: I can allocate some space for you at the Whispers office. It will be very quiet, and no one will disturb you.
say:4:1220221003:1.source_cn: 我可以在血薇话事处给你划一块区域，绝对安静，不会有人来...

say:5:1220221004:1.text: Not bad! Please arrange for some workers to move my tools and equipment there.
say:5:1220221004:1.source_cn: 不错，那你安排点人手，把我这里的工具和实验道具都搬过去吧。

say:6:1220221005:1.text: What made you change your mind?

say:7:1220221006:1.text: The Magister mentioned something, what was it called... high-precision something? A filtration system I've never heard of. I definitely need to study it!
say:7:1220221006:1.source_cn: 梅林刚才说了一个什么高精尖的玩意，嚯！居然有我没听说过...
say:7:1220221006:1.male: The Magister mentioned something, what was it called... high-precision something? A filtration system I've never heard of. I definitely need to study it!
say:7:1220221006:1.female: The Magister mentioned something, what was it called... high-precision something? A filtration system I've never heard of. I definitely need to study it!

say:8:1220221007:1.text: Is that so? Magister Merlin is indeed quite wise.
say:8:1220221007:1.source_cn: 哦，原来是这样……？梅林真博学啊。
say:8:1220221007:1.male: Is that so? Magister Merlin is indeed quite wise.
say:8:1220221007:1.female: Is that so? Magister Merlin is indeed quite wise.

say:9:1220221008:1.text: What's the big deal? It's just a few big words that are hard to pronounce. Once I figure it out, I can invent something even better!
say:9:1220221008:1.source_cn: 有什么了不起的，不就是名字难念了点吗？待我研究一番，一...

say:10:1220221009:0.text: Now I don't have any more time for chitchat. I gotta get to work, see ya!
say:10:1220221009:0.source_cn: 不说了，我得抓紧时间！回见啦！

say:12:1220221010:0.text: Quite impressive. Hugin's proactive as always.
say:12:1220221010:0.source_cn: 不愧是呼金，行动力一如既往地强。
